description: Set the number of zones on the segment. The number of zones is limited to 1-10000 per segment.

7.0.reason: Not listed in the official FLAC3D 7.0 contents command index.
7.0.note: The 2D sketch 'segment'/'segment-node' objects are new in the 9.x sketch workflow; in 7.0 the equivalent 2D geometry is built with 'extrude point' and 'extrude edge' commands.
